title: Schur number S(8), lower bound
statement: Colour 1, 2, ..., n with 8 colours so that no colour holds a solution of x + y = z (x = y allowed), with n as large as possible; it shows S(8) >= n. The best known lower bound is S(8) >= 5372, by Chen, Zhu and Long (2026), by a recurrence from S(6) >= 537; a colouring of 1..5373 or more would improve it.
submission: Text file: the colours of 1..n in order, digits 0..7 (whitespace ignored).
score: n, the length of the colouring; it proves S(8) >= n (larger is better)
